name: notion-paper
description: Natural-language paper-reading workflows for a structured Notion reading journal.

interface.shortDescription: Maintain structured Notion paper notes with short prompts.
interface.longDescription: Use short natural-language requests to start a paper from its PDF, initialize a reading-journal entry, process a named reading section, answer inline questions, add requested formulas or child pages, and safely commit reviewed drafts.
defaultPrompt: 从我附加的 PDF 开始这篇论文的 Notion 阅读任务。
处理“章节标题”的阅读笔记，并生成待确认润色稿。
提交我刚刚确认的当前章节润色稿。
